info.title: Right Ads
info.description: Right Ads Employee Management Platform Backend API

get.description: Check health status of the application, database, and cache.
Check health status of the application, database, and cache.

post.description: Authenticates credentials, checks lockout, and returns access and refresh tokens.
Rotates refresh token and issues fresh access token. Employs reuse detection.
Revokes the current refresh token.
Revokes all active refresh tokens for the current user.
Changes password, enforces policy rules, and revokes other sessions.
Dispatches a password reset link without leaking email existence.
Resets password using verification token.

get.description: Returns profile and permission catalog for the current user.

get.summary: Get non-secret public runtime app configuration
get.description: Public endpoint returning non-secret runtime settings (app timezone, pagination limits, upload limits, minimum supported version, force-update flag, password policy summary, and feature flags). Publicly accessible so mobile clients can evaluate force-update gates and password rules prior to login.

get.summary: Get permission-filtered navigation and modules for current user
get.description: Returns active modules visible to the current authenticated user based on their assigned role permissions, ordered by sort_order, along with the user's permission codes, role display label, department, and security flags.

get.summary: Get effective attendance policy for current user
get.description: Returns the effective attendance policy for the authenticated user (user-specific policy or system default policy), including geofence/selfie requirements, shift hours, and allowed active office locations with coordinates.
Lists all app modules ordered by sort_order. Requires `modules.manage`.

schema.title: Response List App Modules Api V1 App Modules Get

post.description: Creates a new app module registry entry. Requires `modules.manage`.

get.description: Retrieves a single app module definition by ID. Requires `modules.manage`.

patch.description: Updates an existing app module registry entry. Requires `modules.manage`.

delete.description: Deletes a custom app module. Base modules are protected and cannot be deleted. Requires `modules.manage`.

post.description: Provisions a new employee, generates sequential code, creates temporary credentials, and dispatches welcome email.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of employees with search across names, emails, and codes, and filtering by department, role, or active status.

parameters.name: search

schema.description: Search term for name, email, code, or phone
schema.title: Search

parameters.description: Search term for name, email, code, or phone

get.description: Self-service endpoint retrieving personal details and assigned permission codes.

patch.description: Allows employees to update limited whitelisted personal fields (phone number, avatar photo).

post.description: Validates and imports employee rosters from a CSV upload. Supports dry_run mode for pre-validation.

get.description: Fetches full profile, organizational assignments, and resolved permissions for an employee.

patch.description: Updates general employee details, designations, and organizational links.

post.description: Disables an employee account, revokes all active refresh tokens, and enforces last active admin protection.
Re-enables a previously deactivated employee account.
Generates or sets a temporary password for an employee and flags must_change_password=True.

patch.description: Reassigns employee role and permissions, enforcing last active admin demotion protection.
Sets or clears the reporting manager for an employee.
Associates an attendance shift and geofence policy with an employee.

post.description: Records server-time check-in with geofence validation, device binding, and anti-spoofing.
Records server-time check-out, calculates total work minutes, and resolves final attendance status.

get.description: Returns today's shift details, check-in/out timestamps, and current attendance status.
Returns calendar view for the specified month with day-by-day attendance, holidays, leaves, and week-offs.

post.description: Administrator or HR manual override of an attendance record with mandatory reason and immutable audit trail.
Clears registered device ID for an employee allowing them to bind a replacement device.

get.description: Real-time count of active employees across attendance statuses with employee lists.
Full monthly breakdown with working days, hours worked, overtime, and daily status details.
Annual performance metrics, total hours worked, and month-by-month attendance statistics.
Matrix of all employees with daily status codes and aggregate attendance totals.

get.summary: Export Attendance Reports to Excel or PDF
get.description: Generate and stream formatted Excel (.xlsx) or PDF (.pdf) attendance reports.

parameters.name: year

schema.description: Required for monthly and yearly reports
schema.title: Year

parameters.description: Required for monthly and yearly reports

get.description: Fetch list of configured active leave categories (Casual, Sick, Maternity, etc.).

schema.title: Response List Leave Types Api V1 Leaves Types Get

post.summary: Preview Leave Application & Calculate Working Days
post.description: Live calculation of working days, balance availability, and overlap check prior to submission.
Submit a leave application with balance checking, overlap rejection, working-day counting, and past-date validations.

get.description: View remaining, allocated, carried-forward, and consumed leave balances for the given year.

schema.title: Response Get My Balances Api V1 Leaves My Balances Get

get.description: Paginated list of own submitted leave requests and statuses.
Admin/Manager endpoint to list and filter leave applications across employees or teams.
Fetch single leave application by ID.

post.description: Cancel a pending leave application before review.
Approve a pending leave application, deduct balance, mark attendance days as Leave, and notify the employee.
Reject a pending leave application with a required reason/note and notify the employee.
Cancel an already approved leave, restore deducted balance and revert attendance records.
Admin/HR batch allocation of leave balances for all active employees with carry-forward rules from DB.

get.summary: Task completion, overdue, and distribution metrics
Download task attachment via signed URL
List tasks assigned to current employee
List tasks with filters, search, and pagination

post.summary: Create a new task with assignees

patch.summary: Update task properties (title, description, client, project, priority, due date)

post.summary: Bulk assign or reassign task assignees
Update task status along allowed DB transitions

get.summary: Get task activity audit history timeline

post.summary: Post a comment on a task

schema.title: Response List Task Comments Api V1 Tasks  Task Id  Comments Get

post.summary: Upload a file attachment to a task

get.summary: List file attachments with time-limited signed URLs

schema.title: Response List Task Attachments Api V1 Tasks  Task Id  Attachments Get

delete.summary: Unregister device token on logout or device removal

get.description: Read-only paginated catalog of all functional permission codes available in the application.

post.description: Idempotently sets an operational configuration in JSON format without hardcoding in application code.

get.description: Retrieves a specific operational configuration by its unique key string.
Returns a paginated list of immutable security, employee, and business action audit logs.
